description:
A company's or overseas entity's holdings on the Land Registry CCOD/OCOD registers, by Companies House number
    (exact; names are refused): a summary (title count, asset mix, tenure mix, local authorities, postcode districts)
    and a list of titles, 25 per page (at most 25) via `next_cursor`. `include` picks "summary", "holdings" or both.

    Companies and overseas entities only: a person-level proprietor returns covered=false. No directors, officers or
    people are ever returned; do NOT use it to find who runs a company, and do NOT use it for a valuation or equity.
    The summary and list cover the newest window fetched (up to 500 titles), and `basis.decision` says when the
    holding is larger. The portfolio table was built on 18 Sep, so recent deals may be missing; company titles link to
    a UPRN about 65% of the time. An empty answer is not "holds nothing".
    Each call, including each page, is charged when it returns at least one title; covered=false and upstream
    failures are not charged.
    Costs 25 credits (25p).
name: company_portfolio
title: A company's holdings, summarised
